materialization: After both prediction files and their runtime traces are sealed, the launcher writes the two exact manifest paths and their complete preregistered human-ledger cell files to score-jobs.jsonl in this order. Finalize rejects a missing or incomplete ledger surface before a scorer can run. No scorer starts before both manifest hashes exist. The --finalize mode runs the unchanged official scorer exactly once per complete arm, writes each score artifact, and terminally settles the two independent one-shot attempts in the same outer-parallel wave.

recovery.reason: The first flight sealed all 104 REOBSERVE_DIRECT rows, then SUPPLY_UNION_STRIPPED refused before its first contact because twelve unresolved registry unions rendered an empty task contract. Gold and official scorer inputs were not opened.
recovery.contact_rule: Never re-fly the complete observation. Make only the untouched 104-contact supply phase after replacing an empty unresolved renderer result with the fixed non-evidentiary English sentinel. Such samples remain supply-unavailable, always return STOP_M0, and are excluded from reward-memory cells and the eligible always-supply comparator.

jobs.input: the verified complete 104-row source manifest; official score is read-only because the durable attempt is already ABORTED
one fresh complete 104-row SUPPLY_UNION_STRIPPED run manifest

recovery.integrity: The two unchanged official operations start in one outer-parallel two-worker wave only after the fresh supply manifest seals. Each finalize job binds a complete human-ledger cell file and validates it before scoring. The recovered observation remains ABORTED; the fresh supply attempt must become FINALIZED. No dataset sharding or shard-metric averaging is allowed.

aggregation_rule: Never shard a dataset for scoring and never average shard-level metrics. Each worker invokes the unchanged official scorer on one complete arm.
